claims.evidence: No VIN tag, engine code stamp, or model plate visible in any photo; witness could not read brand/model, only generic 'used engine and transmission assembly'.

claims.claim: Direct America drive / low mileage (tokunbo import)
claims.evidence: No import paperwork, customs sticker, odometer, or dealer tag shown; corrosion and dirt visible instead, which is not proof either way.
No video of cranking, running, or gear engagement; unit sits static on ground with hoses/wiring attached but no test shown.

risks.risk: Engine/transmission may not run or may be seized (sold for parts)
risks.proof: Video of engine cranking/running and transmission shifting through gears

risks.risk: Internal wear (pistons, bearings, clutch plates, synchros) unknown
risks.proof: Compression test video or teardown/borescope photos

risks.risk: Fitment to claimed Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 2011-2017 not confirmed
risks.proof: Close-up of engine code stamp or VIN/parts tag matching Pentastar 3.6L spec
risks.if_unproven: price as generic/unconfirmed-fitment assembly, not Jeep-specific premium

risks.risk: Assembly may be incomplete (missing sensors, turbo, belts, ECU)
risks.proof: Full-angle photos with a parts checklist or inventory list

risks.risk: Mileage/hours and true import history unverifiable
risks.proof: Odometer photo, import/customs document, or dealer invoice
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-history, no low-mileage premium

risks.risk: Transmission type (manual vs automatic) and gear condition unstated
risks.proof: Photo of transmission tag/model number or video of shifting through all gears
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown-type, worst-case repair needed

risks.risk: Corrosion/dirt may hide cracks or leaks in casing
risks.proof: Close-up photos of casing seams and oil pan after cleaning
risks.if_unproven: price as having potential leak/casing damage

proof_requests: Close-up photo of engine code stamp or model/VIN tag on block
Video of engine cranking or running, with audio
Video of transmission engaging all gears (or shift lever movement if manual)
Any import/customs paperwork or odometer photo supporting 'direct America / low mileage' claim
Full 360-degree photos showing all sensors, belts, and accessories are present
response.reason: Witness confirms the item is a used engine-and-transmission assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unconfirmed fitment, untested, unknown mileage); the Jeep-specific and low-mileage claims remain unverifiable remotely and should not add premium until proof is supplied.
